response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong general software engineering capabilities and some infrastructure experience, he falls significantly short on critical requirements. Most critically, he has only ~1 year of professional C++ experience versus the required 8 years—a core minimum qualification. Additionally, although he holds senior titles, his career shows primarily individual contributor roles rather than technical leadership of infrastructure teams or cloud compute platforms, which is central to this role. His infrastructure exposure exists but is not deep enough to compensate for these gaps.
strengths: Demonstrates strong software craftsmanship fundamentals with proven expertise in TDD, CI/CD, and establishing coding best practices across multiple roles
Hands-on infrastructure and DevOps experience including GitLab administration, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and exposure to large-scale microservices systems at scale
Proven ability to mentor and educate others through formal workshops, open-source contributions, and community engagement
concerns: Severely limited C++ experience (~1 year professional vs. required 8 years), a core minimum qualification for the role
Career trajectory shows primarily senior individual contributor roles with no clear evidence of leading teams on cloud infrastructure or compute platform projects
Lacks demonstrated production-level cloud architecture specialization; AWS experience is limited to application-level work rather than platform infrastructure
